defects.impact: No Open Graph title for social sharing
defects.business_impact: When this page is shared on social platforms, the default page title is used instead of a custom share title.
defects.remediation_action: Add an og:title meta tag with a compelling share title.

defects.impact: No Open Graph description for social sharing
defects.business_impact: Social shares show generic text instead of a compelling description, reducing click-through from shares.
defects.remediation_action: Add an og:description meta tag (120-200 chars).

defects.impact: No Open Graph image for social sharing
defects.business_impact: Social shares show no thumbnail, reducing visual appeal and click-through.
defects.remediation_action: Add an og:image meta tag pointing to a 1200x630 image.

defects.business_impact: Social platforms may not know how to render this page as a preview card.
defects.remediation_action: Add an og:type meta tag (e.g. "website" or "article").
